name: Seven of Wands
meaning_for_today: Today you may need to defend your position, beliefs, or achievements. Confidence and persistence will help you maintain your advantage despite outside pressure.
card_advice: Stand your ground and trust your abilities. Do not give up your position simply because others challenge you.

upright.general: The Seven of Wands symbolizes resistance, determination, and the courage to protect what has been achieved. It often appears when a person must face rivalry, criticism, or external pressure while remaining confident and resilient.
upright.in_love: Relationships may require effort and protection from outside influences. One or both partners may need to fight for trust, stability, or emotional boundaries.
upright.in_situation: The situation demands persistence and active defense of your interests. Challenges are present, but you have the advantage if you remain focused and confident.

reversed.general: The reversed Seven of Wands points to fatigue, fear of confrontation, or difficulty maintaining control over circumstances. Pressure from others may feel overwhelming, leading to self-doubt or retreat.
reversed.in_love: Arguments, emotional defensiveness, or inability to protect the relationship may create tension. One partner may feel overwhelmed or unsupported.
reversed.in_situation: The situation becomes unstable due to hesitation, lack of preparation, or external pressure. It may be necessary to reconsider priorities and conserve energy.

major.12: Justice supports those who stand firmly for truth.
major.13: A pause or sacrifice is necessary before progress.
major.15: Patience and moderation help maintain control.
major.16: Temptation or unhealthy attachments weaken defenses.
major.17: Sudden upheaval forces you to defend yourself.
major.19: Confusion and uncertainty create inner conflict.
major.20: Success and recognition after standing firm.
major.22: Completion and mastery after overcoming opposition.
